    // Positional contextual typing requires matching type parameter lists.
    export const matching: <T extends { id: string }, U extends T = T>(first: T, second: U) => U =
        <A extends { id: string }, B extends A = A>(first, second) => {
            const a: A = first;
            const b: B = second;
            a.id;
            return b;
        };

            const local: S = value;
            return local;
        };
